latest_release.body:
Find signed `sha256sum.txt.asc` file inside each archive with the binaries.

Released on 13th of November 2025

Note:
Binaries have been built with `GOAMD64=v3` so they will not work on older CPUs (before Intel Core i3/i5/i7-4xxx or Ryzen 1000 series). Additionally `GOEXPERIMENT=greenteagc` was used.
